paragraphs.text: Hokori (ho-KO-ree) , Dust Drinker , is a kami of Kamigawa .

Hokori is a great kami of dust and drought. It has also been referred to as the Swirling Storm and the Searing Wind and is known for not being merciful. It is several times larger then a house and appears as a face with eyes and sharp teeth on a swirling mass of wind.
